age.evidence: Twenty-two male WIS rats ( ≈ 500 g), aged 60 days, were purchased from Charles River Laboratories.

sex.evidence: Twenty-two male WIS rats ( ≈ 500 g), aged 60 days

dosing.doses_raw: psilocybin (1.0 mg/kg) at a volume of 1 ml/kg
dosing.evidence: Interventions were administered intraperitoneally (IP) on all animals one hour after their POE experience... The psilocybin solution was freshly prepared on the day of the POE... dissolving psilocybin... in sterile saline (0.9 %). POEs occurred on Day 1 and Day 12.

handling.evidence: Following 7 days of habituating the animals to handling, the animals were randomly divided into three groups

group_housing.evidence: Rats were housed in pairs with food and water ad libitum for the duration of the experiment (45 days), except where described (individually housed during SPT; SIS groups had cage partners rotated daily).

day_night_flipped.evidence: under a 12-h light/dark cycle... all procedures were conducted during the light circle (06:00 -18:00), except the second POE (18:00 -6:00).

assays.assay_description: Black PVC box 48×48×50 cm, virtually divided into 16 squares (ANY-maze); 15-min free exploration on study day 33; distance travelled and immobile time measured.

application_type.evidence: Interventions were administered intraperitoneally (IP) on all animals one hour after their POE experience

setup_habituation.evidence: not reported (only room acclimation: 'allowed to acclimate for a minimum of 30 min')

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats were introduced into the OFT apparatus and allowed to explore freely for 15 min.

food_restriction.evidence: Standard open field box; no food in apparatus during the 15-min session.

water_restriction.evidence: Standard open field box; no water in apparatus during the 15-min session.

time_to_assay.evidence: Psilocybin given 1 h after POE on Day 1 and Day 12; OFT on D 33 (Fig. 1) — ~21 days after last dose.

sample_size.evidence: For A-G and K: CTL n = 5, SIS-Sham n = 7, SIS-PSI n = 7.

outcomes.summary: Chronic stress reduced distance travelled and increased immobility. Psilocybin slightly but not significantly reversed this inactivity phenotype.
outcomes.statistics: Distance: F(2,16) = 27.07, p < 0.0001; Tukey p < 0.0001, p = 0.0001; SIS-PSI vs SIS-Sham p = 0.2060. Immobility: F(2,16) = 9.684, p = 0.0018; Tukey CTL vs SIS-Sham p = 0.0013; SIS-PSI vs SIS-Sham p = 0.0875.
outcomes.evidence: This inactivity phenotype was slightly, though not significantly reversed, in the psilocybin treated group (Fig. 2A, p = 0.2060; Fig. 2B, p = 0.0875).

B1_num_measures.evidence: Distance travelled (in cm) and immobile time (in sec ) were recorded

B6_cognitive.evidence: The OFT was utilized to assess exploratory activity and locomotion

E1_environment_type.evidence: black PVC plastic box with dimensions of 48*48*50 cm

E6_spatial.evidence: virtually divided into 16 identical squares using the ANY-maze software

E7_social_context.evidence: Rats were introduced into the OFT apparatus individually.

D2_session_duration.evidence: allowed to explore freely for 15 min

D5_followup.evidence: OFT on D33, ~21 days after the last intervention (Day 12).

assays.assay_description: 6-day protocol (acclimatization, training, 12-h food/water deprivation, testing) with rats individually housed; 8-h two-bottle test (1% sucrose vs water, positions swapped every 2 h); sucrose preference % from bottle weights.

setup_habituation.evidence: During the acclimatization period (day 1 -2), each animal was individually housed in a cage containing two bottles of drinking water... to acclimatize the animals to the option of two bottles

setup_restrain.evidence: All animals were allowed free access to both bottles for a total of 8 h

food_restriction.evidence: On day 5, all animals were deprived of food and water for 12 h overnight (18:00 -06:00).

water_restriction.evidence: On day 5, all animals were deprived of food and water for 12 h overnight (18:00 -06:00).

time_to_assay.evidence: anhedonia-like behavior (Ds 34-38); test on final day (~D38), ~26 days after last dose on Day 12.

sample_size.evidence: For H-J: SIS-Sham n = 7, SIS-PSI n = 7.

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin-treated stressed rats showed higher sucrose preference than sham-treated stressed rats, indicating reduced anhedonia-like behaviour.
outcomes.evidence: The psilocybin treated group demonstrated a higher sucrose preference (%) than the sham treated rats (Fig. 2J, t-test, p = 0.0495).

B1_num_measures.evidence: sucrose preference (%)... sucrose consumption (in g) / total consumption (in g) * 100

B4_ethological.evidence: Consumption preference, not distinct ethological acts.

B6_cognitive.evidence: The SPT was employed to evaluate anhedonia-like behavior

B7_automated_classification.evidence: The final weight of bottles was recorded

E1_environment_type.evidence: each animal was individually housed in a cage containing two bottles

E8_food_water.evidence: all animals were provided with a pre-weighed bottle of drinking water and a pre-weighed bottle with a 1 % ( w / v ) sucrose solution

D1_continuity.evidence: Only the day-6 test consumption is reported: 'The final weight of bottles was recorded to calculate the sucrose preference'

D2_session_duration.evidence: All animals were allowed free access to both bottles for a total of 8 h

D3_recording_days.evidence: Only the test day (day 6 of protocol) yields reported data.

D5_followup.evidence: SPT conducted Ds 34-38, >3 weeks after last dose.

D6_circadian.evidence: free access to both bottles for a total of 8 h

assays.assay_description: Conducted in the open field arena over 2 days: training with two objects (day 1), test with a novel object added in a third corner (day 2, 5 min); recognition index computed from object exploration time.

setup_habituation.evidence: not reported (training session with objects described, but no separate apparatus habituation)

setup_restrain.evidence: allowed to freely explore the arena for 5 min

food_restriction.evidence: Open field arena; no food in apparatus.

water_restriction.evidence: Open field arena; no water in apparatus.

time_to_assay.evidence: recognition memory (Ds 39-40); test day ~D40, ~28 days after last dose on Day 12.

sample_size.evidence: For A-G and K: CTL n = 5, SIS-Sham n = 7, SIS-PSI n = 7 (ANOVA df F(2,15) suggests one exclusion).

outcomes.summary: Chronic stress lowered the recognition index; psilocybin-treated stressed rats had significantly higher RI than sham-treated stressed rats.
outcomes.statistics: F(2, 15) = 13.04, p = 0.0005; SIS-Sham vs CTL p = 0.0004; SIS-PSI vs SIS-Sham p = 0.0250
outcomes.evidence: The sham treated group demonstrated a significantly lower RI than the CTL group (Fig. 2K, p = 0.0004), while the SIS-PSI group had a significantly higher RI than the SIS-Sham group (Fig. 2K, p = 0.0250).

B1_num_measures.evidence: The recognition index (RI)... was used to measure novelty preference and memory retention.

B4_ethological.evidence: Time spent interacting with each object used only for RI.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Time spent interacting with each object was recorded to evaluate recognition memory

E1_environment_type.evidence: The NOR protocol was preformed in the open field arena

E3_bedding.evidence: No bedding mentioned in open field arena.

E5_enrichment.evidence: Objects are the test stimuli, not enrichment.

E7_social_context.evidence: Each rat... was placed back in the apparatus

D1_continuity.evidence: Only the test-day RI is reported; no training-session data reported.

D2_session_duration.evidence: allowed to freely explore the arena for 5 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: Training day (day 1) data not reported; only test day (day 2) analysed.

D5_followup.evidence: NOR on Ds 39-40, weeks after last dose.

assays.assay_description: Two open arms (50×10 cm) and two closed arms (45 cm walls), elevated 55 cm; 5-min session; open/closed arm time, open-arm entries and risk-assessment (stretch-attend posture) time measured.

setup_restrain.evidence: allowed to freely explore the arena for a duration of 5 min

food_restriction.evidence: Standard EPM; no food in apparatus.

water_restriction.evidence: Standard EPM; no water in apparatus.

time_to_assay.evidence: anxiety-like behavior (D 41); ~29 days after last dose on Day 12.

sample_size.evidence: For A-G and K: CTL n = 5, SIS-Sham n = 7, SIS-PSI n = 7.

outcomes.summary: Stress reduced open-arm time and entries and increased risk assessment. Psilocybin significantly increased open-arm entries and reduced risk assessment versus sham; open-arm time increase was not significant; closed-arm time unaffected.
outcomes.statistics: Open arm time: F(2,16) = 3.881, p = 0.0423; CTL vs SIS-Sham p = 0.0336. Open arm entries: F(2,16) = 8.100, p = 0.0037; CTL vs SIS-Sham p = 0.0059; SIS-PSI vs SIS-Sham p = 0.0148. Closed arm time: F(2,16) = 0.3328, p = 0.7218. Risk assessment: F(2,16) = 10.10, P = 0.0015; CTL vs SIS-Sham p = 0.0012; SIS-PSI vs SIS-Sham p = 0.0401.
outcomes.evidence: Early psilocybin intervention significantly increased the number of entries into the open arms (Fig. 2E, p = 0.0148)... the SIS-PSI subgroup spent less time assessing risk than the SIS-Sham group (Fig. 2F, p = 0.0401).

B1_num_measures.evidence: Time in open arms, time in closed arms, open-arm entries, and time in risk assessment (stretch-attend) behaviour.

B4_ethological.evidence: Risk assessment behavior was defined as a stretched-attend posture, wherein the animal elongates its neck and shoulders

E1_environment_type.evidence: The EPM apparatus consisted of two open arms... and two closed arms

E2_shelter.evidence: EPM closed arms are part of the apparatus, not a shelter (rubric).

E6_spatial.evidence: EPM scored as single space per rubric.

E7_social_context.evidence: Rats were positioned at the intersection of the four arms

D5_followup.evidence: EPM on D41, weeks after last dose.

assays.assay_description: Plexiglas cylinders (20 cm D × 50 cm H), 23–25 °C water; day 1 15-min pre-swim habituation (no data), day 2 10-min test with last 8 min scored for immobility, swimming and climbing.

setup_habituation.evidence: On the first day, each rat was individually introduced into the warm water-filled cylinder for a 15-min habituation.

setup_restrain.evidence: FST cylinder (rubric: FST cylinder = restrained); 'water depth prevented the rat from touching the container bottom'

water_restriction.evidence: No drinking water accessible during swim test.

time_to_assay.evidence: behavioral despair (Ds 42-43); test day ~D43, ~31 days after last dose on Day 12.

sample_size.evidence: For A-G and K: CTL n = 5, SIS-Sham n = 7, SIS-PSI n = 7. For H-J: SIS-Sham n = 7, SIS-PSI n = 7.

outcomes.summary: Stress increased immobility; psilocybin significantly reduced immobility and increased swimming time versus sham, with a non-significant increase in climbing.
outcomes.statistics: Immobility: F(2,16) = 10.48, p = 0.0012; CTL vs SIS-Sham p = 0.0009; SIS-PSI vs SIS-Sham p = 0.0444. Swimming: t-test p = 0.0379. Climbing: n.s.
outcomes.evidence: The SIS-Sham group spent less time moving compared to the CTL group (Fig. 2G, p = 0.0009)... which was alleviated upon early psilocybin intervention (Fig. 2G, p = 0.0444). Interestingly, time spent swimming (Fig. 2I, t-test, p = 0.0379)... was significantly increased in psilocybin treated rats

B1_num_measures.evidence: immobile time... we further classified active behaviors into swimming and climbing

B4_ethological.evidence: FST immobility/swimming/climbing not ethological per rubric.

E7_social_context.evidence: each rat was individually introduced into the warm water-filled cylinder

D1_continuity.evidence: Day 1 was a 15-min habituation without reported data; only the day-2 test was scored.

D2_session_duration.evidence: testing with a duration of 10 min... recorded for 8 min

D4_baseline.evidence: Habituation swim not a pre-drug baseline; no data reported.

D5_followup.evidence: FST on Ds 42-43, weeks after last dose.

judge_notes: All three candidates identified the same five assays (OFT, SPT, NOR, EPM, FST); no merges or drops needed. Luminex, ELISA and Western blot excluded as non-behavioural.

Dosing schedule set to 'repeated' (deepseek) rather than 'acute': paper states interventions were given 'one hour after their POE experience' and POEs occurred on Day 1 and Day 12; medium confidence because the text is not fully explicit.
time_to_assay recomputed from Fig. 1 timeline (OFT D33, SPT D34-38, NOR D39-40, EPM D41, FST D42-43) relative to last dose on Day 12; gemma's 20160 min and qwen's Day-1-based values discarded.
SPT D2 overridden to score 3 (>6 h) for all candidates: the test session lasted 8 h, which exceeds the 6-h cutoff; D6 = Yes.

SPT/NOR/FST D1 and D3 set to single session/1 day: only test-day data are reported (SPT final bottle weights, NOR test RI, FST day-2 scoring; FST day 1 is explicitly habituation). Overrides deepseek/gemma.
FST B1 set to 2-3 (score 1): immobility, swimming, climbing = 3 measures; deepseek's score 2 and qwen's '4-6' label were inconsistent with the rubric.
EPM B1 set to 4-6 (score 2): open-arm time, closed-arm time, open-arm entries, risk assessment.
OFT D2 = 1 (15 min falls in 15–60 min bin); gemma's score 0 rejected.
D5 follow-up = Yes for all assays (all tests ≥3 weeks after last dose); gemma's 'No' rejected.
SPT E3 bedding scored 0/low (not stated; rubric forbids inference), overriding qwen/deepseek inference.
day_night_flipped = 'no' because the paper states all procedures were conducted during the light phase (06:00-18:00).
